India Enters Ashadha Maas, a Month of Change and Health Awareness

Ashadha Maas, which marks the beginning of summer in India, is also a month of change due to the onset of monsoon season. This period brings significant changes in weather patterns, making it essential for individuals to take extra precautions for their health. As the month begins, people are advised to be mindful of their health and avoid certain activities.
